title: Ineffective
text:
Ineffective. I truly hated this. First of all, it was ineffective at stopping the "creeping/movement." Secondly, the white side which goes on the carpet (if you're using this on top of carpeting) has adhesive that left residue behind.

I didn't even bother to send it back to Amazon. I just threw it in the trash.

I guess this is one of the many products that work fine for some and work terribly for others.

product_metadata.title: Teebaud Non-Slip Rug Pad, Reversible Rubber Gripper, Non Skid Pads for Hardwood, Vinyl, Tile, Laminate Floors, Keep Area Rugs Secure, Natural Materials Safe for Indoor Flooring, ¼”-Thick - 2' x 4'
features: One Pad For ANY Flooring: No need to worry if you have beautiful hardwood floors, laminate flooring, imported tile or marble—or any other type of foundation—because our nonskid ¼-inch thick area rug pads are safe for all of them. We use a specially formulated fiber composition that keeps your treasured rugs firmly in place without marking or damaging what’s underneath.

Streamlined Installation: You’ll be delighted at how fast and easy it is to get your new gripping pad in place and no special tools are required, just a standard household scissors. On clean, dry floors, place the white side of the mat up if you have hard flooring, and the gray side up if you have carpeting. Ensure the grip pad is 1 to 2 inches smaller than your rug (cut with scissors to fit). Use two pads together on oversized rugs—you don’t need splicing tape.

Lasting Durability: While basic rubber rug pads and backing tend to crack, crumble, flatten, and harm flooring, take comfort in Teebaud’s uniquely safe and long-lasting advantages. The solid-body fiber gripper is coated with water-based resin used specifically for its exceptional non-slip properties. The mat is breathable and steady, which extends the life of your original floors and the underlayer of your rug. If you have underfloor heating, keep temps at 89F & below.

For Home Or Office: High traffic areas need a quality non-skid rug pad grip. Use Teebaud’s superior underlay holders for rooms, hallways, and foyers at home and at work. Place your reliable grips under area rugs in meeting rooms and bedrooms, beneath hallway runners, and to hold entryways. Beautiful rugs stay put securely through plenty of busy feet, wheeled equipment, vacuum cleaners, and more.

Teebaud Integrity: Rely on Teebaud for the highest quality pure fiber rug grip pads. Your home and workspace area rugs are sure to hold strong just where you want them, while your base flooring stays in great condition. Grippers can be easily picked up and moved when you redecorate or move. Feel free to contact our friendly team if you ever have questions or comments.
